title: How a harness hands back a dispatched agent's work is not the project's integration
situation: Realizing neutral-conventions, the lead asked whether 'names no branching model' reaches the harness setting by which omp hands an isolated agent's work back as a branch.
decision: Integration is how a change joins the project's shared work. How a harness hands a dispatched agent's work back to whoever dispatched it is the harness's own mechanics, inside the work of one task, and assumes nothing about how the project joins changes; it is outside what being generic over a project's conventions asks of cratylus.
consequences: The harness setting stays as it is; nothing in neutral-conventions changes for it.
